Multimodal wearable biofeedback for phonation practice

SpeechBridge explores how audio, throat vibration and surface muscle activity can support structured phonation practice for people with post-stroke dysarthria. The application is a research prototype and is not a clinical diagnosis or treatment tool.
SpeechBridge combines a smartphone app with wearable sensing to capture microphone, neck-accelerometer and surface EMG information during selected speech-practice tasks.
Practice illustration. It is not a sensor measurement.
The camera cannot see inside your mouth or check your tongue.
